Overview.Title: Overview
Overview.Subtitle: How far your mouse really travelled on the pad.
Overview.NoStreak: Move at least 1 m a day to start a streak
Stats.Title: Statistics
Stats.Subtitle: Totals, averages and records for any period.
Stats.AveragesHint: "Per active day" counts only days you used the mouse. The others spread the total over every day since you started.
Stats.LongestStreak: Longest streak (1 m or more a day)
Games.Title: Games
Games.Subtitle: Where your mouse travels the most. Steam games are found automatically.
Games.Empty: Nothing recorded for this period yet.
Games.OtherAppsHint: Mark an app as a game if it wasn't recognized, or hide it from your statistics.
Games.HiddenAppsHint: Hidden apps don't count in any statistics. Their data is kept, so you can show them again.
Gear.Title: Gear
Gear.Subtitle: Your mice and their DPI. Distance is only as accurate as the DPI set here.
Gear.DpiButtonWarning: If you switch DPI with a button on your mouse, AimOdometer can't see it. Set the new value here (or in the tray menu) so distances stay correct.
Gear.Name: Name
Gear.PadsLater: Mouse pads and glide wear tracking are coming in a later update.
Calibration.Title: Measure your real DPI
Calibration.Instruction: Hold the left button, move the mouse exactly {0} cm in a straight line, then release. Try {1} of {2}.
Calibration.TooShort: That was too short. Hold the left button and move the full length.
Calibration.Done: Done. Apply the result or measure again.
Calibration.SpreadHigh: The tries differ by more than 5%. Measure again for a reliable value.
Calibration.Tips: Tip: line the mouse up against the ruler's edge and slide it without lifting. Clicks here don't do anything else.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Subtitle: Changes apply right away.
Settings.MouseHint: Set the DPI of each mouse by hand, pick a preset, or measure it with a ruler. Press Enter or Save to apply.
Settings.ShowTrayIcon: Always show the icon on the taskbar
Settings.ShowTrayIconHint: Windows 11 hides new tray icons behind the ^ arrow. This shows the AimOdometer icon next to the clock.
Settings.DataHint: Statistics are stored only on this PC, in your user folder. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Settings.ExportLater: Export and delete buttons are coming in a later update.
Settings.Privacy: AimOdometer never reads your keyboard and doesn't touch game memory. It only counts mouse movement and notes which app is active.
Onboarding.WelcomeText: It counts how far your mouse travels on the pad, in real centimeters, even in shooters where the cursor is locked. It runs quietly in the background.
Onboarding.TrayText: AimOdometer lives next to the clock. Hover the icon to see today's distance; click it to open this window.
Onboarding.LanguageText: You can change it any time in Settings.
Onboarding.MouseText: Type the DPI of the mouse you play with (you'll find it in G HUB, Synapse or your mouse's app), or pick a preset. Not sure? Use Measure DPI with a ruler.
Onboarding.DpiHint: Find the DPI in your mouse's software (G HUB, Synapse and others), or measure it with a ruler.
Onboarding.AutostartText: So no session goes uncounted. It uses about 4 MB of memory and no CPU while the mouse is still.
Onboarding.PrivacyNote: Your keyboard is never read. Statistics stay on this PC unless you sign in with Steam later.
